objection.quote: Thus Xiang cannot always complete equal partition unless Liu's cuts are exactly n of the grid points. Since Liu can avoid grid points, Xiang cannot necessarily achieve equal partition.
objection.witness: Missing statement: for EVERY Liu division there exists a Xiang reply using at most n cuts holding Liu to at most the claimed value (e.g. via a subset-sum/pigeonhole gap plus a cancellation construction). The quoted passage shows the only candidate strategy considered (completing an equal grid) fails, and the text then only says 'need different Xiang strategy to upper bound', deferring the obligation entirely.
objection.load_bearing: Optimality of the claimed c depends solely on exhibiting such a universal Xiang response; the text explicitly abandons its one attempt and proposes brute-force search instead.
